description: We are students that are interested in space challenges
summary:
Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” is an interactive website about the NASA equipment and spacecraft that remain on the Moon and Mars. We created a digital archive where people can learn about different missions, what each object was used for, and what happened to it after its mission ended. We included information, pictures, a timeline, and a quiz to make the website more interesting and easier to understand.

This project addresses the challenge by sharing the stories of these forgotten explorers in a creative way. It is important because it helps people understand how much these missions contributed to space exploration and reminds us that even when a mission ends, its discoveries are still valuable.
details:
Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” is an interactive website about NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars. It allows visitors to explore different missions, learn about the equipment, and discover its contributions to space exploration through stories, a timeline, and a quiz.

The main benefit is making space exploration easier and more interesting to understand. Our goal is to show that even when missions end, their discoveries are still important.

We used Canva and digital tools to create our website. We focused on making it creative, easy to navigate, visually appealing, and informative while keeping the information accurate.
